content.value_statement: Creators often run out of specific short-form ideas and fall back on generic posts. This skill turns a niche, pillar, or draft idea into grouped, ranked video concepts.
actual_capabilities: Generates grouped short-form video ideas for a niche, audience, or platform.
Builds 3 to 5 content pillars with example post directions.
Expands topics through matrix styles, mining prompts, and repurposing angles.
Suggests mining sources, including comments, Reddit, autocomplete, and competitor outliers.
Ranks ideas with audience fit, hook potential, and production effort in mind.
Balances evergreen ideas with limited trend candidates for weekly planning.
limitations: It does not guarantee that any idea will go viral.
It does not access live platform analytics unless the user provides examples.
It cannot show verified real videos or statistics from a niche by itself.
Results improve when the user provides niche, audience, and platform context.

use_cases.title: Plan a Creator Idea Backlog
use_cases.description: Turn a niche into pillars, idea groups, and ranked candidates for future filming.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Weekly Content Calendar
use_cases.description: Create a balanced mix of evergreen ideas, trend tests, and repurposed angles.

use_cases.title: Convert Research Into Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Use comments, communities, search completions, and outlier videos as idea inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Generate 20 Ideas
prompt_templates.prompt: I create short-form videos about [niche] for [audience]. Generate 20 ideas grouped by pillar, then rank the top five.

prompt_templates.title: Build Content Pillars
prompt_templates.prompt: My niche is [niche] and my audience is [audience]. Draft 3 to 5 content pillars with five example posts per pillar.

prompt_templates.title: Mine Audience Demand
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mining mode for [niche]. Create a weekly research checklist, then turn comments, Reddit, autocomplete, and outliers into 15 ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Monthly System
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a four-week short-form content system for [niche] with pillars, evergreen balance, repurposing rules, scoring, and a review cadence.

output_examples.input: I make home espresso videos and need fresh ideas.
output_examples.output: Gear: compare a budget grinder with a premium grinder. Technique: show the 3-second tamp check. Buying: rank upgrades by impact.
Use a mistake angle, a pricing audit, a personal story, a myth-busting take, and a step-by-step rate reset.

output_examples.input: Plan this week for a fitness coach.
output_examples.output: Use four evergreen posts, one trend test, and one repurposed client question. Rank each idea by clarity and filming effort.

best_practices: Provide niche, audience, platform, and any format constraints before asking for a large idea list.
Ask for grouped and ranked ideas so the output is easier to choose from.
Use mining mode weekly to refresh ideas with real audience language.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic viral ideas without a niche or audience.
Do not treat the output as proof that a video will perform.
Do not copy competitor videos without changing the mechanic and angle.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee viral videos?
faq.answer: No. It improves idea volume and structure, but it does not predict performance.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It supports TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts idea planning.

faq.question: Can it build content pillars?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft 3 to 5 pillars and generate examples for each one.

faq.question: Can it use my existing posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste examples or describe them, and it can infer pillars and new angles.

faq.question: Does it research live trends?
faq.answer: No. It gives research workflows, but live trend data must come from the user or external tools.

faq.question: Is it useful for brands?
faq.answer: Yes. Brands can use it to turn audience research and product themes into short-form concepts.
